articles.title: Old Wires, Big Problem: Why U.S. Flights Stopped on Friday
articles.summary: A router problem during a copper-wire upgrade halted U.S. takeoffs for four hours on Friday, delaying or cancelling more than 15,000 flights.

articles.title: Flu Season Starts Early in the U.S.
articles.summary: Flu is spreading early this year, with seven states reporting high activity and Louisiana hit hardest; doctors urge vaccination before Thanksgiving travel.

articles.title: Tanker Crashes Into Cruise Ship on the Mississippi
articles.summary: A tanker that lost steering hit a docked cruise ship in New Orleans on Friday; all 197 aboard survived and investigators are now examining the cause.
